designReview.evidence: The independent 2026-09-28 review rates D01-06 at 78/80; its course-by-course Q16 entry and §17 generation boundary are included in the shared review report.

criteria.evidence: 06-mini-exhibition.md §4 includes two stateful curation and blind-entry-view revision interactions; §17 keeps both local.
Section 4 diagnoses a blocked focal exhibit and requires actual anonymous visitor evidence followed by one-layout-change retry.
Sections 3 and 7 change visitor/entry conditions and keep a two-exhibit core distinct from the optional third exhibit.
Sections 3-4 require a real unbriefed visitor view and do not infer general preference from one reaction.
Section 4 feedback cites what the actual visitor saw first and prompts a single layout revision before a second view.
Sections 7 and 10 retain an editable new exhibition, entry/focus/panorama views and actual visitor feedback.
